question: Where should the śakti and the kīlaka be placed in the ritual body?
premises: The śakti is an element to be placed in nyāsa.
The kīlaka is another element to be placed.
The śakti is placed on the feet and the kīlaka on the whole body.
inference: Therefore one should place the śakti on the feet and the kīlaka on the whole body.
plain_english: One should place the śakti on the feet and the kīlaka on the whole body.
